title: The Silent Ember
author: Juniper Winterbourne
blurb: Bram Winterbourne, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
